mapper.select: SELECT s.call_scenario_id , s.call_title , s.situation_text FROM call_scenarios s WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM call_simulator i WHERE i.call_scenario_id = s.call_scenario_id) ORDER BY RAND() LIMIT 1

SELECT item_id , call_scenario_id , item_order , item_type , label , stat_label , question , answer , keywords , weak_feedback , score FROM call_simulator WHERE call_scenario_id = #{callScenarioId} ORDER BY item_order
SELECT item_id , call_scenario_id , item_order , item_type , label , stat_label , question , answer , keywords , weak_feedback , score FROM call_simulator WHERE item_id = #{itemId}
SELECT session_id , user_id , training_type , call_scenario_id , started_at , ended_at , score FROM training_sessions WHERE session_id = #{sessionId}
SELECT result_id , session_id , result_type , call_item_id , item_order , score , attempts , detail_json FROM session_results WHERE session_id = #{sessionId} AND call_item_id = #{callItemId}
SELECT result_id , session_id , result_type , call_item_id , item_order , score , attempts , detail_json FROM session_results WHERE session_id = #{sessionId} ORDER BY item_order
